verdict.rationale: The GST portal's own help documents a first-party GST Offline Tool for uploading invoices (plural) to file returns, which suggests batch handling of many items. The evidence never explicitly describes bulk or multi-item operations, their scope, or any limits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch operations, scope beyond invoice upload (e.g., bulk actions on registrations, notices, or ITC), API-level bulk endpoints for AI-native automation, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Learn how to upload invoices through GST Offline Tool to file returns.
